items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: The implementation pins pytest collection to absolute verbosity -1, preserves configured addopts such as marker filters, and leaves non-pytest runners inert as requested.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: The subprocess contract and existing fail-soft empty-list behavior are unchanged; only pytest's collection verbosity is made deterministic.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user-input, authentication, secret, query, or rendering boundary is changed.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Real pytest subprocess tests cover no verbosity, positive verbosity, deep positive verbosity, quiet verbosity, marker-filter preservation, and the non-pytest fallback.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: The production path still launches exactly one collection subprocess; added subprocess cost exists only in focused tests.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: The change remains in the existing collector and its existing test module; both files remain within the repository's 300-line source budget.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized format or producer-consumer data contract changes; this is a subprocess CLI-argument correction whose real pytest boundary is exercised directly.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: uv run shared/scripts/tools/scan_test_hygiene.py --diff completed with no findings.
